seo.title: Incheon Airport Transfer | Pak Lee's Car
seo.description: Private pickup and drop between Incheon Airport and your Seoul hotel. One way, up to eight people with luggage, fixed ₩150,000 per vehicle.

hero.h1: Incheon pickup, with your name on a sign
hero.lede: You land after a long flight with luggage, a phone that doesn't work yet, and no won in your pocket. I meet you at the arrivals gate, carry the cases and drive you to your hotel door for a price agreed before you took off.

itinerary.title: Send me the flight number
itinerary.body: Not the landing time — the flight number. I track the actual arrival, so a two-hour delay costs you nothing and there's nobody to phone about it from the air.

itinerary.title: Immigration and bags
itinerary.body: Usually forty minutes to an hour at Terminal 1 or 2, longer on a heavy morning. I'm already parked and waiting; the clock isn't running against you.

itinerary.title: The sign with your name
itinerary.body: T1 exit gate 5 or 6, T2 exit gate 2, unless we've agreed otherwise. If your phone has no signal yet, just walk out and look — I'll be standing where I said I'd be.

itinerary.title: 70 to 90 minutes into Seoul
itinerary.body: Longer in weekday rush hour. Free Wi-Fi in the car, and chargers at every row so you can message home before your SIM is sorted.

itinerary.title: SIM card or cash, if you need it
itinerary.body: The airport SIM counters and the ATMs that take foreign cards are worth five minutes before we leave. Tell me and we'll stop; it's easier here than in the city.

itinerary.title: Your hotel door
itinerary.body: Not the corner, not the nearest station. Bags out of the boot and up to the entrance, then payment in cash or by transfer — whichever suits you.

faqs.q: What if my flight is delayed?
faqs.a: Nothing changes. I watch the flight number, not the schedule, and I don't charge for a delay you didn't cause. The same goes for a slow immigration queue.
Yes — one way, per vehicle. Pickup and drop-off are ₩150,000 each. Book both together and I'll hold the same car for your departure.
Four large cases plus cabin bags is comfortable. Six large cases with eight people is not — tell me the real number of bags and I'll say straight away if it fits.

faqs.q: Can you do an early morning departure?
faqs.a: Yes. A 04:30 pickup for a 07:00 flight is normal for me. Book it the day before rather than the night of, so I can plan the run.
I can bring one or two if you ask in advance, at no extra cost. I can't produce them on the spot, so mention it when you book.
Cash in won at the end, or a bank transfer. No deposit before we've spoken, and no card machine in the car.

reels.body: Short clips from pickups and days out.

cta.body: Send me your flight number, the date and how many bags. I'll confirm the price before you fly.
